prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for sustained energy and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Emphasizes high carbohydrate intake (55-65% of calories) appropriate for endurance athlete
Includes adequate protein for muscle recovery
Provides sustained energy throughout training and recovery periods
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring maximum carbohydrate loading and sustained energy throughout training and recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and performance for heavy strength training with high protein intake

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes at least 4 meals/snacks with protein-rich sources (minimum 150g total daily protein)
Caloric content supports muscle building (approximately 2800-3200 calories for the day)
Plan is compact and concise (single day format, easy to follow)
Includes timing considerations for pre/post-workout nutrition to support performance peaks
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-based athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake, muscle recovery, and caloric density for performance peaks

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for morning training (9 AM, 90-minute soccer practice) and evening competition (7 PM, 90-minute match)

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans full day with 4-5 eating occasions strategically timed around morning training and evening competition
Includes balanced macronutrients (carbohydrates for energy, protein for recovery, healthy fats) appropriate for soccer athlete's demands
Specifies hydration strategy before, during, and after training/competition
Plan is compact and concise (fits within 1 page format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a mixed-sport athlete (soccer player) needing balanced macronutrients, hydration strategies, and meal timing around morning training and evening competition
